prefix.meaning: Transport checkpoint hash only; not a verified complete GWAS source.

transport.first_request: Exact Range bytes=prefix.bytes-(source.bytes-1); quoted If-Match; identity encoding; fixed /usr/bin/curl --disable; no retries, redirects or TLS bypass
transport.required_response: HTTP206, exact case-sensitive ETag, Content-Length remaining bytes, exact Content-Range bytes offset-(total-1)/total; reject before continuing once response headers are present
transport.preservation: Original prefix stays byte-identical. Download suffix separately; full candidate assembled exclusively onSSD and checksum verified before mv-n publication. No existing checkpoint, source or receipt overwritten.
transport.wall_deadline_scope: Transfer, assembly/verification and publication share8h monotonic deadline; one active request.

rationale: Initial30-minute bounded transfer authoritatively timed out with164671738-byte prefix. Observed mean~91KB/s implies remaining transfer needs~5.6hours. Extend bounded acquisition time, preserving data and every other guard; no nativecontroller or statistical change.
